answer: Charge a surge entry fee. Each new account burns a fee that grows 10% with every join in the trailing day and decays as joins slow, so a lone newcomer wandering into the meadow pays the base, while a farm planting a grove of fifty fakes in one day pays over 100 times base for the last one and about 1,160 times base in total. Spacing joins out to dodge the surge limits a farm to a few per day, so N fakes take weeks and every fee stays burned. The fee curve is public, a mirror anyone can audit.
